description: ERA5 South Asian low-pressure-system catalogue with hourly-complete physical-event identities throughout January-December and the v5.5.1 six-hour wind-plus-land-closed-isobar IMD-equivalent intensity method

identity.track_id: one hourly-complete physical event and the only public event identifier; use for plotting, counts, matching and climatology

calibration.existence: v5.4 fixed core retained exactly, with a liberal off-monsoon computational preselection followed by the unchanged v5.5 strict final ERA5 physical-event gate
calibration.population: events must enter 65-100 E, 0-32 N on an observed fix; genesis location, storm identity, year and official-list membership are not rules
calibration.intensity: v5.5.1 background-removed circulation-wind thresholds plus a land-only two-closed-isobar depression floor, all with six-hour persistence
calibration.frequency_reference: official IMD seasonal system counts for 2020-2023; IBTrACS event recall audited independently for 2015-2025
